name: Textile
description: Tape and toilet paper. Don't laugh: the workshop runs on them. Any will do.
success: Tape and paper. Thank you. Don't tell anyone what holds a plate carrier together.

name: Measurements
description: I can't fit a man I haven't seen move. Go to the factory locker rooms, where the workers changed, and get out again. I'll watch how you come back through the door.
success: You favour the left shoulder. I'll set the straps for it.

name: One Lamp
description: I work by one lamp and one sink. You'll want both. Build a lavatory in your hideout and run two rolls of tape through it. Slowly. Tape is a craft too.
success: Even edges. You were patient. That's most of it.

name: Patchwork
description: A carrier is only as good as its seams. Sewing kits and paracord you found yourself; shop thread frays. Ripstop from anywhere.
success: Good thread, good cord. The seams on this one will outlive us both.

name: Night Shift
description: Run your lavatory for me: two batches of anything from it. And grow up a little first, I don't trade with rookies.

name: Bad Seams
description: I want to see how other people's armor fails. Three Scavs on the factory floor, hit in the chest, then bring me a PACA you took off someone out there. I'll read the holes.
success: Stitched by a machine, cut by a bullet. I'll do better.

name: Hard Plates
description: Aramid and ceramic are the bones of real armor, and resin holds them together. Bring them found in raid. I'll know if they're not.
success: Bones and resin. I'll have a carrier for you before the glue sets.

name: Rebar and Canvas
description: Builders left rolls of ripstop at the customs construction site, under the rebar. Walk the site and carry three rolls out yourself. No cuts, no burns.
success: Clean rolls. I'll line a pack with these.

name: Army Surplus
description: The old army checkpoint in the woods kept spare kit for a whole platoon. See what's still on the shelves, and three PMCs who came for the same thing won't need theirs.
success: Surplus is surplus. They won't miss it.

name: Resort Linen
description: The resort's west wing had a laundry with aramid sheeting in the supply room. Don't ask why. Go through the west wing and carry two pieces out, found there.
success: Hotel aramid. I won't ask either.

name: Lab Coats
description: The custodians in Lab Zero wear a weave I've never seen. Take three of them down so I can study the cloth, and come back up with all your own seams intact.
success: A tight weave. Too tight. Whoever made it never had to move in it.

name: Heavy Set
description: For the heavy set I need a sink that runs hot, two sewing kits off it, and two lots of ceramic shards found in the field. It will take time. It always does.
success: Heavy and true. Wear it with the straps the way I set them.

name: Masterwork
description: One rig in my life I want to make without cutting a corner. Ceramic, resin and aramid, all found out there, more than you think. I'll measure twice. I'll measure ten times.
success: Finished. I unpicked it twice. It's the best thing I've made.
